description: Valoir Atelier is an editorial, high-craft Shopify theme built for boutique optical ateliers, luxury sunglass designers, and independent eyewear brands. Engineered with native 3D WebGL frame inspection, AR virtual try-on models, responsive bilingual English/Arabic RTL typography, and frictionless selling plan subscription capabilities. [REQUIRES_HUMAN_COPY: Review and customize description before submitting]
features: Interactive 3D / AR eyewear visualization with native WebGL orbital inspection and iOS QuickLook USDZ integration
Comprehensive Subscriptions and Selling Plans support for lens replenishment and frame care memberships
Native RTL support with bidirectional CSS logical properties for multi-region luxury commerce
WCAG AA compliance with accessible modal focus traps and high-contrast color hierarchy
Sticky add-to-cart bar and slide-out ajax bag with live shipping thresholds and prescription notes
